Monjasa is a global partner in the oil and shipping industries. Its core business includes oil trading and supply, terminal operations, agency, and ship-owning activities. Founded in Denmark in 2002, Monjasa today employs approximately 750 people, serves customers in more than 800 ports and operates a fleet of 30 vessels. The group also provides offshore hotels and project services through CBED Floating Hotels.

Global financial controlling and reporting

As Group Controller, you will join the group controlling team and work with the preparation and consolidation of monthly internal financial statements, budgets, and year-end external financial statements. You will validate financial figures across group companies and work closely with finance teams in Denmark and Finance Managers worldwide.

Specific work tasks:

• Controlling and reviewing of a broad variety of Danish entities within various industries.

• Participating in preparation of internal reporting to Management and the Board of Directors.

• Participating in the preparation of the group annual report and the year-end process for a broad variety of Danish entities.

• Further develop and maintain group-related controlling and review processes, ensuring lean and effective procedures.

• Building and maintaining strong relations with internal stakeholders.

• Participating in budget and estimate processes.

• Act as sparring partner for the group accounting team.

• Analysing group financial performance and development.

• Preparing audit material.

• Assisting with the quality assurance of consolidated figures.

• Assisting group Tax with corporate income tax returns.

Based in Fredericia, you will report to the Group Finance Director and join a group finance team of 10 employees. The role includes 5-10 travel days a year and offers flexibility regarding working from home.

Ambitious and curious financial profile with strong interpersonal skills

We expect you to hold a cand.merc.aud or HD-R and have at least three years of experience as an auditor working with international clients. Experience from a similar role in an international organisation is an advantage. You know Danish accounting requirements and IFRS, have strong skills in Excel, ERP, consolidation and BI tools, and you communicate fluently in Danish and English.

We are looking for a Group Controller who is independent and proactive. You are committed to meeting deadlines and delivering high-quality work on time. Curious and unafraid to challenge the status quo, you are ambitious and committed to achieving high-quality results. You possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and communicate effectively with individuals at all levels and across cultures.

Join Monjasa – a global company with a strong team spirit

Monjasa offers a fulfilling career in a modern global organisation with strong learning opportunities. The values Respect, Ambition, Curiosity and Smile & Joy, together with the purpose “Monjasa means personal business”, guide how colleagues work together. Despite its global growth, Monjasa has maintained a flexible culture and strong relationships across locations.

Head of HR Nordics

Milexia Nordics A/S

Do you want take responsibility for HR across Milexia Nordics’ international organisation and act as a trusted sparring partner to the Managing Director and the wider management team?

As Head of HR Nordics, you will set up the HR department for Milexia Nordics, define and implement suitable processes and structures to support the business. Your role includes responsibility for ensuring operational and legal compliance for the legal entities across the organisation. You confidently develop and mature HR processes, structures, and policies, and ensure strong alignment between local requirements and company-wide standards in Milexia Nordics.

A key part of the role is to be a close sparring partner to the Managing Director and the wider management team. This entails acting as a strategic, commercially minded sparring partner who offers support on recruitment processes, legal cases, as well as development of leadership capabilities and talent. The objective is to be perceived as a trusted, competent, and proactive problem-solver and business partner on all local HR matters, someone who can challenge their colleagues where appropriate, always in a respectful manner.

Tasks and responsibilities within the role will include, but not be limited to:

HR Operations, Processes and Compliance

• Take overall responsibility for HR across the international organisation – and translate business strategy to high-impact HR initiatives.

• Ensure that core HR processes operate efficiently and professionally across all locations.

• Oversee HR-related processes involving payroll, pensions, benefits, holidays, absence and employment conditions, working with the relevant internal and external providers.

• Maintain appropriate HR policies, documentation, GDPR compliance and confidential handling of employee data.

• Identify opportunities to improve and streamline HR processes, systems and ways of working.

• Provide relevant HR reporting and management information to support informed decisions on people, costs and organisational development.

Strategic HR- and Management Support

• Act as a trusted and qualified sparring partner to the Managing Director and the wider management team.

• Advice on organisational structure, recruitment, workforce planning, employee development, performance management and retention.

• Challenge management constructively and provide independent, well-founded HR advice when needed.

• Handle complex employee relations matters, conflicts, dismissals and other sensitive situations with professionalism and sound judgement.

• Contribute actively to building an organisation that supports business objectives and continued growth.

• Define and drive employer branding activities in collaboration with marketing and management team.

Recruitment, Talent and Development

• Support managers in recruiting the right people for Milexia Nordics’ international organisation.

• Develop professional approaches to onboarding, employee development, succession planning and talent retention.

• Help managers attract, develop and retain skilled and motivated employees.

• Establish a structured approach to performance reviews, employee objectives and ongoing development.

• Identify skills gaps and future organisational needs as the business evolves.

International HR and Employment Law

• Ensure that employment contracts, employee policies, HR processes and practices are handled professionally and in accordance with applicable local legislation.

• Have a strong understanding of European employment law and the key differences between the countries in which Milexia Nordics operate.

• Work with local legal advisers and external specialists whenever specific local expertise is required.

• Establish consistent HR standards across the organisation while respecting local legislation, cultures and working practices.

Commercially minded HR lead with broad HR experience in an international context

You have strong experience from a similar role in an international, small- or medium-sized commercial organisation, and in combining operational HR responsibilities with strategic business partnering and management support. Ideally, you have been instrumental in setting up an HR function before and enjoy a diverse workday with operational as well as strategic tasks and are able to balance and prioritise both soft and hard HR tasks. Your educational background is probably a relevant university degree within HR or HR Law.

To succeed in this role, it is imperative to have a good knowledge of employment law, employee relations and HR compliance, a strong HR toolbox and a solid insight into managing HR processes in an international context. As a person you are outgoing, enjoy being the sparring partner for the management team and thrive with organisational development where you ensure that top talents are identified and nourished.

On a personal level, you are a good listener and a pragmatic, robust problem-solver with a hands-on approach to your work and thrive in an ever-changing environment with stakeholders with high demands. You possess excellent communication skills, have a strong commercial awareness and the ability to work independently, prioritise effectively and take ownership in an organisation without dedicated HR resources in every country. You are fluent in English and Danish, written as well as verbally.

Milexia Nordics A/S

Founded in 2003, Milexia Nordics is a specialist distributor of passive and electromechanical components, RF/Microwave products, and cable harness solutions for the electronics industry in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Finland, Latvia, Estonia, and Lithuania.

The company employs over 40 people based in 7 different countries and has customers in 30 countries around the world. Following years with strong growth, Milexia Nordic’s turnover is currently in excess of DKK 200 million and is expected to grow 15-20% annually in the coming years, whilst maintaining a healthy profitability.

In spring 2024, the company became a part of Milexia Group. Milexia is a leading European technology distributor, headquartered in France, and with offices in Italy, Spain, Germany, UK, Hong Kong, India and Singapore. They successfully operate within RF and Microwave, Power and HMI components, Satcom and Broadcast equipment, Timing and Synchronisation products, and Rugged Computers, with value added services including engineering design and maintenance. Milexia’s DNA is based around their excellent relationships with their customers and suppliers, striving to Making access to technology easier!

Apply for this unique position with Milexia Nordics

The opportunity

Founded in 2016, Mover is a Danish logistics technology company on a mission to change logistics for good, reducing waste and making people’s lives better.

Are you passionate about building great software products? Do you obsess over your customers? Are you interested in working with the latest state-of-the-art AI-driven development practices in order to invent and simplify? Would you like to have an outsized impact in a small Copenhagen B2B SaaS company, and make your mark on the Nordics last-mile logistics market? If so, Mover might be the right place for you.

We are currently brewing up new product ideas, and in need of strong product managers. We are looking for someone willing to take ownership of specific commercial goals and realize them with a great product. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a backlog. We need a product leader who enjoys spending time with customers, challenging assumptions, making difficult prioritization decisions, and working closely with engineering and leadership to shape the future of our last-mile platform.

If that’s something for you, then please read on!

Role overview and responsibilities

As a Product Manager you will:

• Turn strategy into reality: Launch a new B2B SaaS product in the first 12 months.

• Take ownership and deliver results on revenue, gross profit and related commercial goals for your product.

• Lead a small product team in a matrix-style org structure (not a people manager, but a team leader).

• Use AI to its full potential - in the product development process, and in the product itself.

• Perform market research and help drive our continuous discovery process.

• Talk to customers. A lot. Both existing and prospects.

• Build long-term relationships with senior stakeholders and customers.

• Take a primarily data-driven approach to product development and product operations.

• Have a real, measurable impact on the daily lives of thousands of drivers across Europe.

Your mindset

• You are driven by purpose and want to contribute to our mission of changing logistics for good.

• You are driven, tenacious, and can work independently. You think big and insist on the highest standards. You have a bias for action and accomplish more with less. You listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have strong opinions and no issue voicing them. However, once a decision has been made, you commit wholly to the path forward.

• You can sell a vision to customers.

• What success looks like (12 months)

• You have successfully launched a new product.

About you

• We imagine you have 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, but we are also interested in equivalent qualifications from marketing, sales or other commercial functions, with relevant project management experience and customer obsession.

• Preferably experience in launching (not just operating) a new B2B SaaS product.

• The ability and curiosity to quickly learn a complex domain (last-mile logistics).

• The ability to navigate ambiguity and create clarity.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

• Experience working with cross-functional product teams.

• Understanding of software life-cycle processes: How software is built, maintained and scaled.

What we offer

• A high degree of responsibility from day one, working alongside experienced colleagues.

• A steep learning curve in a fast-moving technology company.

• Autonomy, trust, and support to do the best work of your career.

• An open, collaborative environment with talented peers across multiple functions.

• Aaaand, a great lunch, modern offices and a cool location at Islands Brygge in the center of Copenhagen…

Mover’s values

We move fast. We expect people to own problems end-to-end, not wait to be told what to do. You know best, so you need to bring a lot of creativity. We obsess over the people who use our software, from logistics planners to drivers, and we would rather ship a small improvement this week than a perfect one next year. We are direct and honest with each other, including about our own mistakes, and we hold a high bar for quality.

• 
Lead with integrity. We believe that integrity is a reciprocal value. It means treating others as we wish to be treated. With respect, honesty, and sound ethics

• 
Be accountable. We embrace freedom in decision-making, initiative, and actions while accepting full responsibility for outcomes and results

• 
Push boundaries. We challenge norms, innovate, and move fast to drive changes to continuously improve things for everyone affected by our products and services

• 
Play, as a team. We are serious without taking ourselves too seriously, and balance having fun with achieving great things, together

Interested? We would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Are you approaching the end of your studies and looking for a graduation project early 2027. Does deep dive into the protection of the primary equipment enabling transport of wind energy to shore excite you? Then we have the project for you.

The projects

Protection study

Today we apply state of the art, cutting edge protections of the primary equipment, 220/66kV transformers, shunt reactors, subsea cables etc. Functions like line differential protection, restricted earth fault protection, distance protection with fiber optic accelerations schemes and different mechanical protections.

But how well do the different protections cover the primary equipment?

Are all protections feasible, considering how often we statistically experience faults?

Grounding

Today the MV grid, connecting the wind turbines to the Offshore Sub Station is impedance grounded. This creates different problems and side effects that needs to be considered during engineering. Some primary equipment becomes expensive and hard to procure. Protection against earth faults becomes challenging because of the reduced fault current.

Investigate the benefits and disadvantages of isolated, impedance and effectively grounded MV grid.

How will the protections need to be set up?

What will the implications be on primary equipment, transformers, cables, wind turbines etc.

Your Profile & Qualifications

We image that you are studying to become an Electrical Engineer. As a person you are ambitious and result oriented. You have an analytical mindset and strive to find solutions for complex problems and at the same time you enjoy collaborating within a team. Furthermore, you have a strong interest in learning and taking on challenges.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have the following qualifications:

• Interest in electrical systems.

• Focus on digitalization and innovation.

• Can communicate in English, both written and verbal.

• Flexible, committed, loyal and dedicated.

• Great communication skills.

With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Søren Borre Kreipke, Manager, HV Protection & Secondary at SOBK@semcomaritime.com

Flatpay is looking for an experienced Product Manager to join our Financial Services team. In this role, you'll help develop our customer-facing banking product, including the app that supports small and medium-sized businesses in their day-to-day financial activities. Hands-on product management experience with customer-facing apps is essential for this role.

You will work closely with engineers, designers, operations, commercial teams, and external partners to turn customer needs, business priorities, and technical requirements into clear product improvements. The Fabrication Support team at DTU Nanolab is seeking one to two Process generalist for permanent positions. 

As a Process Generalist in the Fabrication Support team, you will be working in a highly advanced cleanroom environment. In this role, you will support and advise students and researchers at DTU and external users on fabrication processes, as well as train users in the operation of state-of-the-art semiconductor processing equipment. You will also collaborate closely with industrial partners to realize their devices, designing and executing complete fabrication processes to meet customer requirements.

The job
A significant part of your working day will be spent in the DTU Nanolab cleanroom. We are looking for a person who already has substantial experience in advanced micro-fabrication in a cleanroom environment You should enjoy helping and teaching students and other facility users to operate advanced tools. You have great attention to detail and a structured approach to developing and fine-tuning fabrication processes.

Our expectations of you
We expect you to hold a Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline with at least 3 years’ experience in semiconductor fabrication. We also expect that you are already skilled in essential nano- and microfabrication techniques such as

• UV lithography
• Thin film deposition
• Deep reactive ion etching
• Scanning electron microscopy
We also expect that you

• Can work independently on given tasks
• Will systematically document process development results
• Enjoy working on projects alone, but also in cooperation with other team members
• Are fluent in English
At DTU Nanolab, safety is a core value. We are therefore seeking candidates who are comfortable working in a highly safety-focused environment and who can meet the following physical and mental requirements:

• Comfortable wearing specialized personal protective equipment (PPE) when required.
• Able to respond promptly and appropriately in emergency situations, including evacuations.
• Capable of performing duties that involve extended periods of standing and movement.
• Confident working with potentially hazardous chemicals and gases while following established safety protocols and procedures.
What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in an international environment. A job where you will work with state-of-the-art semiconductor fabrication equipment. The Technical University of Denmark is a leading university in Northen Europe, and our facility is among the largest and most advanced fair access facilities in Europe. Please notice that this is not a research position, it is a technical position with emphasis on user assistance and customer fabrication orders.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement for academic employees with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The position is a full-time position. Starting date is 1 January 2026 (or according to mutual agreement).

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 15 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Head of Fabrication Support, Maria Matschuk on 4525 5723 or mmat@dtu.dk.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Nanolab is the National Center for Nanofabrication and Characterization in Denmark and an open-access research infrastructure at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU). As one of Europe’s largest fair-access micro- and nanofabrication centers, it offers a large cleanroom and advanced electron microscopy facilities. DTU Nanolab supports cutting-edge research and small-scale production within MEMS/NEMS, photonics, and quantum technologies, covering nano- and microfabrication as well as advanced analysis of hard and soft matter. Since 2018, DTU Nanolab extended to provide expertise in soft matter from small molecule complexes to biological cells.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own charge point management for public CPOs on the Spirii platform. You will own the product area end-to-end and work across multiple teams, from charger connectivity and protocols to monitoring and device capabilities. You will shape the strategy, build the commercial case for it, and help drive its impact on revenue, margin and retention.

**The Role

**As Product Manager for Public CPOs, you will work closely with engineering, design and commercial teams to solve meaningful customer problems in ways that deliver business impact. You will shape the product vision, own an outcome-focused roadmap, and lead discovery based on evidence. You will also share your knowledge with other Product Managers and help build a strong, data-driven product culture across the organisation.

**What You Will Do

**

• Vision & Strategy: Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for charge point management, and decide which problems are worth solving and which are not.

• Outcome-Focused Roadmapping: Prioritise initiatives based on customer value, business impact and feasibility.

• Discovery & Validation: Lead continuous discovery with customers, design and engineering. Test ideas early and use evidence, not assumptions, to make decisions.

• Commercial & Go-to-Market: Build business cases that tie your product area to ARR, gross margin and retention. Work with Sales, Marketing and Operations on pricing, packaging and go-to-market for charge point capabilities.

• Standards & Regulation: Follow standards and regulatory changes (OCPP 2.0.1/2.1, OCPI 2.3, AFIR) and turn them into roadmap decisions.

• Partnerships: Help shape integrations and partnerships with third-party hardware manufacturers for compatibility, scale and long-term flexibility.

• Delivery & Product Craft: Help your teams ship predictably, and write clear strategy docs, PRDs and customer communication.

• AI & Agentic Tools: Use agentic tools in your daily work, and share prompts, skills or workflows with other PMs.

• Stakeholder Communication: Communicate context, trade-offs and results clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership, and use data to align priorities when they conflict.

• Knowledge Sharing: Support other Product Managers, share what you learn, and contribute to a collaborative product culture.

**Qualifications

**

• 5+ years in product management, ideally in EV charging, energy, IoT or B2B SaaS platforms, or equivalent domain depth.

• Experience owning a product or product area end-to-end, ideally across more than one team, with measurable results.

• Strong technical grounding in APIs, platforms and integrations. OCPP experience is a strong plus.

• Experience building business cases, and ideally working on pricing and packaging with commercial teams.

• Ability to influence across functions and seniority levels, including saying no with data.

• Hands-on experience with AI and agentic tools in your daily product work.

• Experience defining and tracking product metrics with tools like Mixpanel, Metabase, PowerBI or Datadog.

• Excellent written and verbal communication in English.

**Benefits

**It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work life balance.

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

**About Spirii – Who We Are

jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for building strategic customer relationships and turning complex opportunities into long-term business success? Are you motivated by helping accelerate the energy transition through offshore wind solutions? If so, this could be your next career opportunity. 

At Semco Maritime, we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to strengthen our Renewables Service business. You will play a key role in developing strategic sales opportunities, supporting key customer relationships, and securing service contracts for offshore wind assets in selected international markets. 

Your position 

As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will have end-to-end commercial ownership of strategic sales opportunities within the Renewables Division. Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will lead the external commercial journey from early opportunity identification and qualification through tender management, contract negotiation, award, and handover to project execution. 

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. 

You will be accountable for building and converting a strong pipeline of strategic opportunities into profitable contracts while developing long-term relationships with selected key customers. You will shape winning commercial strategies based on customer needs, market dynamics, and Semco’s capabilities, and ensure that commercial priorities are aligned across relevant functions.

You will contribute to defining our commercial focus for selected customers and market segments, helping ensure that we invest our efforts where Semco Maritime has the strongest position to win. Your success will be measured by your ability to build strategic customer relationships, develop high-quality pipeline and convert complex opportunities into sustainable and profitable business.

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, our office located in Copenhagen or our future office in Aarhus. The position is full-time, and you can expect to up to 30 travel days per year. 

Your tasks & responsibilities 
As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will take ownership of strategic sales opportunities throughout the entire commercial lifecycle.

Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will develop winning strategies, build strong commercial relationships, and identify growth opportunities across existing and new accounts. You will play a central role in shaping account strategies, developing customer-focused value propositions, and ensuring that commercial solutions are aligned with both customer needs and operational capabilities.

In addition, you will represent Semco Maritime in customer interactions and industry forums, contribute valuable market insights, and help strengthen our commercial processes and best practices across the organisation.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 

• Driving strategic sales opportunities from qualification through contract award and handover.
• Developing and executing winning strategies for key tenders and commercial opportunities.
• Building and maintaining strong relationships with strategic customers and supporting key account development.
• Leading customer negotiations in collaboration with technical, operational, legal, procurement, and finance stakeholders.
• Identifying and pursuing business growth opportunities, including cross-selling, upselling, and framework agreements.
• Ensuring high-quality commercial proposals, risk assessments, and governance approvals.
• Promoting a strong culture of safety, quality, compliance, and integrity in all commercial activities.

Your profile & qualifications 

We are looking for a commercially driven professional who thrives in a customer-focused environment and has a proven track record of managing complex sales opportunities - preferably from the wind industry. 

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you: 

• Have significant experience with complex B2B sales, opportunity and tender management, contract negotiations, and the development of winning strategies for strategic sales opportunities.
• Bring experience from offshore wind, renewable energy, maritime, technical service, or related industries.
• Have a strong understanding of customer decision processes, competitive positioning, value creation, and commercial risk management.
• Have experience with key account management, account planning, and building long-term customer relationships.
• Are comfortable coordinating cross-functional sales and bid activities involving multiple stakeholders.
• Possess strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills and work in a structured, proactive, and results-oriented manner.
• Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing, and are willing to travel as part of the role. 

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.
Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.
